item.coloph: bdag 'dra stong rgyung mthu chen gyis/ nag mo gsang ba gcig sgrub 'di/ snying dang 'dra ba'i gter du sbas/ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ gshen gyi bstan pa srung bar shog shan pa'i sgrub thabasaM brgya rtsa brgyad la/ 'di stag ri rong gis zab/ bdag gis smon lam mthu btsan shog lho ston tshul khrims bla g.yung gzhon tshul rdor tsug de la phyol na shog ser bzhugs pa la/ rkab (dka') ba spyad nas thang bzhi zhus//
